faq: Is this round the clock support?

No. Support runs on US working days, and a ticket bundle ends when it is used up or the order period ends. Round the clock cover is not part of these packages, and ongoing plans are quoted separately.
Do you speak to my customers directly?
By default we write replies for you to send, in your voice. If you prefer, we can reply from your help desk as a team member. You choose, and we agree the tone first.
What systems do you need access to?
Your help desk or shared inbox, staging environment, logs and code repository, added as a collaborator. We do not ask for passwords, and we avoid customer personal data unless a ticket needs it.
What if a ticket needs a big fix?
We explain the cause, offer a workaround and give an estimate for the proper fix. Small fixes are included in the ticket. Larger ones can be a separate order or part of a monthly plan.

desc:
When something breaks, your customer wants a clear answer, not a guess. Ecom Swift LLC provides technical support for SaaS teams: we handle a set number of tickets, reproduce each problem, fix it or explain the workaround and draft the reply.

## What is technical support for a SaaS team?

Technical support is the layer between your customers and your developers. A customer reports that something does not work. Someone has to understand the report, check the logs, reproduce the problem, decide whether it is a bug, a misuse or a missing feature, and answer in language the customer understands.

Many teams do this with the same developers who build the product. Every ticket interrupts them, and the answers vary from person to person.

## Why good technical support protects your product

A slow or unclear reply turns a small issue into a lost customer. People forgive problems when they receive a quick, honest explanation and a next step. They do not forgive silence or a reply that clearly misses the point.

Support also feeds the product. Each ticket is a piece of information about where the product confuses or fails people. Teams that only close tickets miss the pattern, and the same questions keep returning.

## How faster, clearer support improves results

The first effect is trust. A customer who gets a correct reply within a business day, with a fix or workaround, is more likely to stay and to report the next problem instead of leaving silently.

The second is time. Handing technical tickets to a person who can read logs and code removes interruptions from your developers, who can then finish planned work. The third is learning: a summary of recurring issues shows which fixes would remove the most tickets, so effort goes where it counts.

## What a good technical support service includes

- A first reply within the time agreed for your package.
- Each issue reproduced, not just read and answered from memory.
- A clear diagnosis: bug, setup problem, user error or feature request.
- A fix applied in code when a change is needed and agreed.
- A workaround for the customer while a larger fix is planned.
- A reply drafted in plain language, ready for you to send.
- Saved replies for questions that keep coming back.
- A tidy shared inbox or help desk, with labels and statuses that make sense.
- A report on recurring issues and how to prevent them.
- A runbook so your own staff can handle the common cases.

## How we work

You choose how tickets reach us: forwarded emails, a shared inbox or a seat in your help desk tool. We read each one, reproduce the problem on your staging or test account and note the cause. Where a code change is needed, we make it on a branch and send it for review. Then we write the reply and, depending on what you agree, you send it or we post it for you.

The Basic package handles a bundle of tickets with reproduction, drafted replies and a summary. Standard handles more tickets, applies fixes where code must change, tidies your help desk and reports the top recurring issues. Premium adds a priority queue with same-day first replies, a support runbook, saved replies, a fix-focused recurring issues report and a training call for your support staff.

This is not round-the-clock cover, and we do not take over your customer relationships. We work through the ticket bundle and give you what you need to answer well.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Include the customer's steps, screenshots and account details in each ticket.
- Tell us which customers are most important.
- Share your tone of voice and any reply templates.
- Let us know when a ticket is urgent.
- Read the recurring issues report and act on it.

**Avoid:**
- Forwarding a ticket without the original message.
- Promising a customer a fix date before we have diagnosed it.
- Sending us tickets that are really sales questions.
- Leaving old tickets open without a status.
- Sharing customer passwords.

## Who this is for

This suits a small SaaS company whose founders answer every technical ticket themselves. It suits a team with a launch coming, expecting a wave of questions. It also suits a company that wants its support staff trained to handle the common cases without a developer.

## What we need from you

Access to your help desk or shared inbox as a team user, repository access as a collaborator for tickets that need code, and a staging or test account. We never need passwords. We ask for the minimum access needed and keep customer details private.
